title: Salsa
tagline: A vibrant Afro-Caribbean dance music tradition shaped by horns, percussion, and clave.
summary: Salsa is a broad Afro-Caribbean dance music tradition that developed through Cuban forms and New York's Latin music scene. Its arrangements often feature layered percussion, piano, bass, and brass, organized around clave rhythms. Salsa has grown into many regional styles while remaining central to social dance and Latin music culture.

pillars.name: Celia Cruz
pillars.why: Cruz became one of salsa's most celebrated vocalists, known for her commanding performance and repertoire.

pillars.name: Willie Colón
pillars.why: Colón helped shape New York salsa through trombone-led arrangements and influential collaborations.

pillars.name: Héctor Lavoe
pillars.why: Lavoe's expressive singing became central to the sound and identity of classic New York salsa.
